newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Shing raises HK$623 mln.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing raises HK$623 mln.

text.p: Shun Shing Holdings Ltd has announced a share placement and new issue aimed at raising HK$623.3 million in working capital, the company said in an announcement published on Monday

The 52.42 million shares which were to be placed out were owned by COSCO (H.K.) Property Development Ltd, which held 61 percent of the listed company through True Smart International Ltd, the announcement said.
The shares would be placed to independent third parties at a price of HK$4.68 per share.

The placement price represented a 15.0 percent discount to the closing price of HK$5.50 per share on May 2, and a discount of about 2.3 percent to the simple average of the closing prices of the shares for the previous 10 days of HK$4.79, the notice said.
The company would also issue 134.4 million new subscription shares at the same price of HK$4.68 per share to COSCO (H.K.).
These shares represented about 20 percent of the existing issued share capital of the company or about 16.7 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.

The net proceeds from the issues would be approximately HK$623.3 million and would be used to finance new property and construction projects, to repay bank borrowings and as additional general working capital.
Following the completion of the placement and the subscription, the holding of COSCO (H.K.)in the company would be 61.0 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.
